title: Port krn state check and resume into the Product CLI
body:
Outcome: `bin/krn state check|resume` runs Product code; src/cli/state-forward.ts and its spec/receivers.json pending entry are deleted; ~/.codex/krn is no longer read by any PATH command.
Why: t-ez3nsc3 pointed PATH krn at the Product checkout and forwards only `state` to the legacy release (~/.codex/krn/current/scripts/lib/state, about 950 lines plus lessons and kernel helpers). That release is the last legacy dependency of the lead loop.
Proof: `krn state check --root .` and `krn state resume --root .` print the same verdict and exit code as the legacy release on this repository (capture under test/fixtures), with KRN_STATE_ENTRY unset and ~/.codex/krn moved aside.
Scope: this repository.
